overview: A coffee bean storefront where customers browse beans, build a cart, and place orders, with an admin area to manage products and orders.
features: Browse a catalog of coffee beans with photos, roast level, origin, and price
Filter and sort beans, and search by name or origin
Open a product page with tasting notes and available weights
Add beans to a cart that persists across page refreshes
Check out with delivery details and receive an order reference
Admin sign-in to add, edit, and remove products
Admin order inbox to track and update order status
